title: B2B Site Studio SiteSpec
description: Draft-friendly structured source of truth for one WordPress site or a network of SEO sites.

siteModel.description: Canonical site type selected by the user; UI may label this as siteType.

x-semanticValidation: Every catalog.category.productIds entry must resolve to catalog.products[].id.
Every catalog product, variant, category, site, region, lead form, Telegram destination, and asset/artifact identifier must be unique inside its scope.
Category path must match parentId and category graph must not contain cycles.
Every asset ID referenced by brand, catalog, products, variants, and design prototypes must exist in assetRegistry.
design.selectedVariantId must exist in design.prototypes for publish_ready documents.
Every leadForm.destinationIds entry must resolve to an enabled Telegram destination with secretRef.
Every enabled publishable lead form must have a Telegram route for the project/site/region context and the route destination must exist.
WordPress siteUrl host must match deployment target host and deployment host must match the publishable site host.
Staging deployment cannot use wordpress_production target and production deployment cannot use wordpress_staging target.
No arbitrary host from user text can become a Telegram, WordPress, artifact, or GitHub target without an explicit typed destination.
